target.title: fix(openai): show current default model in missing-auth hint
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users who authenticate OpenAI through the ChatGPT/Codex OAuth profile could see a missing-API-key hint that names a stale default model after the OpenAI default changes.

## Why This Change Was Made

The missing-auth hint now formats the OAuth profile suggestion from `OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL`, the same source used for OpenAI provider defaults. The change is scoped to the OpenAI provider message and includes a regression test that fails if the hint stops following the shared default.

## User Impact

OpenAI OAuth users get a current model suggestion when direct OpenAI API auth is missing. There is no config, schema, or provider behavior change.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/openai/openai-provider.test.ts extensions/openai/openai-provider-missing-auth.test.ts`
  - 2 test files passed; 46 tests passed.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`
  - Passed.
